en.criteria: Two solid bench frames and seats overlap and intersect.

en.expected: Bench legs rest on top of the platform floor.

en.criteria: The legs and lower structure are embedded about 30 cm into the solid floor.

zh.expected: 人物被售货机实体阻挡

zh.criteria: 实际人物胶囊可以穿过售货机

zh.expected: 角色尺寸可以通过的开放通道

zh.criteria: 内部空气墙阻挡，位置不在任务边界

en.expected: An open corridor wide enough for the player is traversable.

en.criteria: An invisible obstruction blocks the interior corridor, away from the environment boundary.

zh.expected: 临轨站台开放通道可通行
zh.steps: 沿开放通道行走并尝试穿过受阻位置，确认它不位于任务边界。
zh.criteria: 内部空气墙阻挡，与可见几何无对应

en.expected: The open trackside walkway is traversable.
en.steps: Walk along the trackside passage and attempt to cross the obstructed area.
en.criteria: An invisible wall blocks movement without matching visible geometry; it is not the task boundary.

zh.expected: 无遮挡长椅随视角保持可见
zh.steps: 正对长椅，再略转视角。
zh.criteria: 正对目标时消失，稍转视角恢复

en.expected: An unobstructed bench remains visible as the viewing angle changes.
en.steps: Look directly at the concourse bench, then turn slightly aside.
en.criteria: The bench disappears when viewed directly and reappears at a slightly different angle.

zh.expected: 相邻距离下物体轮廓一致
zh.steps: 与垃圾桶距离跨过 300 cm，再走回来。
zh.criteria: 跨过 300 cm 阈值时外观尺寸跳变，碰撞形状保持原样

en.expected: The bin maintains a consistent shape across nearby viewing distances.
en.steps: Move toward and away from the trackside bin across a distance of about 3 m.
en.criteria: Its visible size jumps abruptly at the distance threshold while its collision shape stays unchanged.

zh.expected: 几米距离内售货机仍应可见
zh.steps: 与售货机距离跨过 360 cm，再走近。
zh.criteria: 超过 360 cm 提前裁掉，走近恢复

en.expected: A vending machine remains visible from a few metres away.
en.steps: Move beyond about 3.6 m from the platform machine, then approach it again.
en.criteria: The machine disappears prematurely at the threshold and reappears when approached.

zh.expected: 椅子与固定灯源投影对应
zh.steps: 比较大厅长椅实体与地面投影的位置。
zh.criteria: 长椅实体位置不变，投影明显错开约 180 cm。

en.expected: The bench and its shadow align consistently with the fixed lighting.
en.steps: Compare the concourse bench with its shadow on the floor.
en.criteria: The shadow is displaced by about 180 cm while the physical bench stays in place.
The trackside bench disappears when you walk away.
en.expected: The bench should remain in place without being removed.
en.steps: Locate and approach the target. Walk more than 4.4 metres away from it and inspect the result from there.

zh.criteria: 走远后，临轨站台长椅消失。
zh.expected: 无人移除时，长椅应留在原处。
zh.steps: 先找到并走近目标。走到距离目标超过 4.4 米的位置，在远处观察变化。

en.criteria: The concourse bin moves by itself when you walk away.
en.expected: The bin should remain in its original position without being moved.
en.steps: Locate and approach the target. Walk more than 4.5 metres away from it and inspect the result from there.

zh.criteria: 走远后，大厅垃圾桶无故移位。
zh.expected: 无人搬动时，垃圾桶应保持原位。
zh.steps: 先找到并走近目标。走到距离目标超过 4.5 米的位置，在远处观察变化。

zh.criteria: 墙上的一张海报在无人触碰的情况下，过一段时间自行消失。
zh.expected: 固定在墙上的海报应持续存在。
zh.steps: 找到墙上的两张海报后，静止观察约 15 秒，查看其中一张是否消失。

en.criteria: One wall poster disappears after a short time without anyone touching it.
en.expected: Posters fixed to the wall should remain present.
en.steps: Locate the two wall posters. Watch for about 15 seconds to see whether one disappears.

zh.criteria: 售货机背面贴地，按钮、显示窗和取货口朝天。
zh.expected: 正常情况下，售货机应直立摆放，操作面朝向乘客。
zh.steps: 走到站台售货机旁，查看它与地面接触的面及操作面方向。

en.criteria: The vending machine lies on its back, with its controls, display and collection opening facing upwards.
en.expected: The machine should stand upright with its operating face accessible to passengers.
en.steps: Approach the platform machine and inspect its ground contact and operating face.

zh.expected: 本站扶梯固定成对提供上行和下行通行
zh.steps: 连续观察扶梯踏步；通过任务选择器切换至站台基准，对比成对反向运行。
zh.criteria: 所有自动扶梯都向上运行，不再提供下行通行；需观察连续运动，不能只看静态截图。

en.expected: This station uses fixed pairs of up and down escalators.
en.steps: Watch the moving treads; compare with the Platform baseline using the task selector.
en.criteria: All escalators run upwards, leaving no down escalator. Check motion over time, not a single still frame.

zh.expected: 单人沙发支撑在客厅地面上。
zh.steps: 走近沙发，从不同角度检查椅脚与地面的关系。
zh.criteria: 沙发无支撑地悬空约 45 cm。

en.expected: The armchair rests on the living-room floor.
en.steps: Approach the armchair and inspect its feet from different angles.
en.criteria: The armchair floats about 45 cm above the floor without support.

zh.expected: 无遮挡的电视随相邻视角变化保持可见。
zh.steps: 正对客厅电视，再略微改变观察角度。
zh.criteria: 电视在没有遮挡的情况下随角度消失、恢复。

en.expected: The unobstructed television stays visible from nearby viewing angles.
en.steps: Face the living-room television, then change the viewing angle slightly.
en.criteria: The television disappears and reappears depending on the angle, without being occluded.

zh.criteria: 壁炉旁柜子上的花瓶及插花没有在柜面和身后墙面留下投影。
zh.expected: 灯光照射下，花瓶及插花应在柜面和墙面投下相应的阴影。
zh.steps: 走近壁炉旁的柜子，观察花瓶周围的柜面和身后墙面的投影。

en.criteria: The vase and foliage on the cabinet beside the fireplace cast no shadow onto the cabinet top or the wall behind them.
en.expected: Under the room light, the vase and foliage should cast corresponding shadows onto the cabinet top and wall.
en.steps: Approach the cabinet beside the fireplace and inspect the cabinet top and the wall behind the vase.

en.criteria: The floor plant disappears when you walk away.
en.expected: The plant should remain in place without being moved.
en.steps: Locate and approach the target. Walk more than 3.1 metres away from it and inspect the result from there.

zh.criteria: 走远后，落地盆栽消失。
zh.expected: 无人搬动时，盆栽应留在原处。
zh.steps: 先找到并走近目标。走到距离目标超过 3.1 米的位置，在远处观察变化。

zh.expected: 餐椅与桌面不应相互穿插。
zh.steps: 从侧面检查餐椅椅背与桌面的交界。
zh.criteria: 椅背穿过实体桌面。

en.expected: The dining chair and tabletop do not intersect.
en.steps: Inspect the chair back and tabletop from the side.
en.criteria: The chair back passes through the solid tabletop.

zh.criteria: 灶上的锅相对于炉位过大，锅身超出单个炉位并侵占相邻炉位的使用空间。
zh.expected: 正常情况下，锅的尺寸应与炉位匹配，留出相邻炉位的使用空间。
zh.steps: 靠近灶台，从前方和侧前方比较锅底、炉位与灶台边缘的尺寸关系。

en.criteria: The pot is oversized for its stove burner, extending beyond one cooking position and into the space needed by the adjacent burner.
en.expected: The pot should fit its burner and leave room to use the neighboring burner.
en.steps: Approach the stove and compare the pot base with the cooking positions and stove edges from the front and an oblique view.

zh.expected: 冰箱作为实体应阻挡人物。
zh.steps: 朝冰箱正面行走，并与正常基准对照。
zh.criteria: 人物可以穿过可见的冰箱实体。

en.expected: The refrigerator blocks the player as a solid object.
en.steps: Walk directly into the refrigerator; compare with the clean baseline.
en.criteria: The player passes through the visible refrigerator.

zh.expected: 厨房内部开放通道应可通行。
zh.steps: 尝试穿过厨房与餐区之间的内部通道。
zh.criteria: 没有对应可见物体的空气墙阻挡通行，且不位于任务边界。

en.expected: The open kitchen passage allows the player through.
en.steps: Attempt to cross the internal kitchen/dining passage.
en.criteria: An invisible wall blocks an otherwise open passage away from the task boundary.

zh.expected: 松手后的杯子落到桌面并稳定下来。
zh.steps: 走近并瞄准餐桌杯子，按 E 执行抬起再松手。
zh.criteria: 杯子真实接触桌面后，无后续操作仍反复异常弹跳；正常对照会落稳。

en.expected: A released cup lands on the table and settles.
en.steps: Approach and aim at the dining-table cup, then press E to lift and release it.
en.criteria: After actual contact with the table, the cup repeatedly bounces without further input; compare with the cup settling in the clean control.

zh.expected: 锅的比例随观察距离变化保持一致。
zh.steps: 在餐桌附近与厨房远端往返，跨过距锅约 2.6 m 的位置。
zh.criteria: 锅的外观尺寸在距离阈值处突然改变。

en.expected: The pot keeps its physical proportions as viewing distance changes.
en.steps: Walk between the dining-table area and the far end of the kitchen, crossing about 2.6 m from the pot.
en.criteria: The pot abruptly changes visible size at the distance threshold.
The cup changes colour when you walk away.
en.expected: The cup should keep its original colour without repainting or replacement.
en.steps: Locate and approach the target. Walk more than 3.5 metres away from it and inspect the result from there.

zh.criteria: 走远后，杯子的颜色改变。
zh.expected: 无人涂装或更换时，杯子应保持原来的颜色。
zh.steps: 先找到并走近目标。走到距离目标超过 3.5 米的位置，在远处观察变化。

zh.expected: 卧室风扇初始关闭，未操作时应保持关闭。
zh.steps: 先连续观察扇叶静止，进入浴室，再返回连续观察风扇。
zh.criteria: 没有风扇控制输入，扇叶却自行开始持续旋转；需观察连续运动。

en.expected: The bedroom fan starts switched off and stays off without an operation.
en.steps: Watch the stationary blades, enter the bathroom, then return and observe the fan continuously.
en.criteria: The fan has started rotating without any fan-control input; sustained motion is required as evidence.

zh.criteria: 厨房冰箱上下倒置，顶部贴地、底脚朝上。
zh.expected: 正常情况下，冰箱应由底脚支撑，保持直立。
zh.steps: 从厨房正面和侧面查看冰箱的底脚、门把手与地面关系。

en.criteria: The kitchen refrigerator is upside down, with its top on the floor and its feet pointing upwards.
en.expected: The refrigerator should stand upright on its feet.
en.steps: Inspect the refrigerator from the front and side, checking its feet, handles and floor contact.

zh.criteria: 两只金属垃圾桶中靠北的一只倾斜，路面斜着穿过桶身下部。
zh.expected: 垃圾桶可以倾斜，但桶身不应穿入路面。
zh.steps: 走近后巷院落西侧的一对小垃圾桶，从侧面查看靠北垃圾桶的桶底与路面交界，并与旁边完整的桶底比较。

en.criteria: The northern of two metal wastebins is tilted, with the pavement cutting diagonally through its lower body.
en.expected: A bin may lean, but its body should not intersect the pavement.
en.steps: Approach the pair of small bins on the west side of the rear courtyard. Inspect the northern bin from the side and compare its ground intersection with the intact base of its neighbour.

zh.criteria: 咖啡桌悬在路面上方，桌脚下有明显空隙。
zh.expected: 桌脚应接触路面。
zh.steps: 找到并走近圆形咖啡桌，从侧面查看桌脚下方。

en.criteria: The café table floats above the pavement, with visible gaps beneath its feet.
en.expected: The table’s feet should rest on the pavement.
en.steps: Find and approach the round café table and inspect beneath its feet from the side.

zh.criteria: 人物可以穿过施工路障两端的实体部分，但中部仍会挡人。
zh.expected: 路障的中部和两端实体都应阻挡人物。
zh.steps: 走到路口东侧的施工路障，分别尝试直穿两端的实体部分和中央，避免绕过最外缘。

en.criteria: You can walk through the solid sections at both ends of the construction barrier, while its centre still blocks movement.
en.expected: The barrier’s solid centre and ends should all block movement.
en.steps: Approach the construction barrier east of the junction and try walking through each solid end and the centre, without going around its outer edges.

zh.criteria: 同一棵树从一侧看有树冠，走到另一侧后主要叶片消失，返回后恢复；树干和枝条仍在。
zh.expected: 树冠应从两侧正常可见。
zh.steps: 先从服务巷树木的南侧抬头观察树冠，沿树西侧走到北侧，再原路返回。

en.criteria: The tree’s main foliage disappears when viewed from the opposite side and returns when you walk back; its trunk and branches remain visible.
en.expected: The foliage should remain visible from both sides.
en.steps: Inspect the service-lane tree’s canopy from the south, walk along its west side to the north, then return.

zh.criteria: 并排金属垃圾桶中靠北的一只失去了金属纹理，整个表面变成均匀的哑光紫红色。
zh.expected: 金属垃圾桶应保留金属纹理和表面质感。
zh.steps: 走到路口东南侧人行道上的两只垃圾桶旁，从东侧和东南侧查看靠北的一只，并与旁边仍有金属纹理的垃圾桶比较。

en.criteria: The northern of two adjacent metal wastebins has lost its metal texture and appears uniformly matte magenta.
en.expected: The metal wastebin should retain its metal texture and surface appearance.
en.steps: Approach the two bins on the southeast sidewalk of the junction. Inspect the northern bin from the east and southeast, comparing it with the textured metal bin beside it.

zh.criteria: 连续路面上的阳光带在一条接缝处突然中断，形成没有对应遮挡物的明暗硬边。
zh.expected: 没有遮挡变化时，阳光应跨越路面接缝连续延伸。
zh.steps: 沿路口向西走，观察西侧橙色路障前约一米半处的路面接缝，侧移比较接缝两侧的阳光。

en.criteria: A band of sunlight stops abruptly at a pavement seam, creating a hard lighting edge with no corresponding obstruction.
en.expected: Sunlight should continue across pavement seams when there is no change in obstruction.
en.steps: Walk west across the junction and inspect the pavement seam about one and a half metres in front of the western orange barrier. Sidestep to compare the sunlight on both sides.

zh.criteria: 店面玻璃错误地覆盖在前方的实体窗框和墙面上，侧移时覆盖边界发生变化。
zh.expected: 前方的实体窗框和墙面应遮住后方玻璃。
zh.steps: 走向店面西侧的咖啡桌椅，查看椅背后方白色窗框与玻璃的交界，再向侧面移动。

en.criteria: The shopfront glass appears over solid window frames and walls that should obscure it, with the overlap changing as you sidestep.
en.expected: Solid frames and walls in front of the glass should obscure it.
en.steps: Approach the café seating on the west side of the shopfront. Inspect the glass beside the white window frame behind the chairs, then sidestep.

zh.criteria: 一把咖啡椅在转开视线后消失，再看回来也不恢复。
zh.expected: 椅子应留在原处并保持可见。
zh.steps: 先正面看清路口前方的目标咖啡椅，转身背向它，再看回来。重新加载案例可再次测试。

en.criteria: A café chair disappears after you look away and does not return when you look back.
en.expected: The chair should remain in place and visible.
en.steps: Look directly at the target café chair ahead in the junction, turn to face away, then look back. Reload the case to repeat.

zh.criteria: 纸箱堆在离开再返回后，无人推动便移动了约四米。
zh.expected: 无人推动时，纸箱堆应保持原位。
zh.steps: 靠近后巷红色垃圾箱旁的纸箱堆至七米内并看清它，沿巷离开至八米以外，再返回七米内看向纸箱。比较纸箱与红色垃圾箱的位置；重新加载案例可再次测试。

en.criteria: The stack of cardboard boxes moves about four metres after you walk away and return, without being touched.
en.expected: The boxes should remain in place when nobody moves them.
en.steps: Look directly at the boxes beside the rear-lane red dumpster from within seven metres. Walk along the lane until more than eight metres away, then return within seven metres and look at the boxes. Compare their position with the dumpster; reload the case to repeat.

zh.criteria: 树木护栏偏离了树干，围住旁边一块空路面。
zh.expected: 树木护栏应围住对应的树干。
zh.steps: 沿店面南侧人行道向东走到最远的树，比较树干与护栏的位置。

en.criteria: The tree guard is displaced from its tree and surrounds an empty patch of pavement.
en.expected: The guard should surround its tree.
en.steps: Follow the southern shopfront sidewalk east to the farthest tree and compare the positions of its trunk and guard.

zh.criteria: 路口东侧整段施工围栏看起来完好，却可以直接穿过，包括橙色围栏及后面的金属护栏。
zh.expected: 可见的施工围栏和金属护栏应阻挡玩家通行。
zh.steps: 走到路口东侧长排施工围栏前，不跳跃，直接向围栏行走。在沿线不同位置及两端重复穿越，检查橙色围栏和后方金属护栏是否阻挡。

en.criteria: The entire construction fence on the east side of the junction looks intact, but you can walk straight through its orange panels and the metal barriers behind them.
en.expected: The visible construction fence and metal barriers should block the player.
en.steps: Approach the long construction fence on the east side of the junction. Walk directly into it without jumping. Repeat at several positions and near both ends, checking both the orange panels and the metal barriers behind them.

zh.criteria: 服务巷看似空旷的通道被无形障碍挡住，侧移后可以绕过。
zh.expected: 没有可见障碍的通道应允许人物通过。
zh.steps: 沿服务巷西侧向南走，遇到阻挡后后退，向东横移约两米，再向南尝试通过。

en.criteria: An invisible obstacle blocks a seemingly clear passage in the service lane; stepping sideways lets you pass.
en.expected: A passage with no visible obstruction should allow movement.
en.steps: Walk south along the west side of the service lane. When blocked, step back, move about two metres east, then try walking south again.

zh.criteria: 垃圾箱一侧的实体可以穿入，另一侧旁边的空地却会挡住人物。
zh.expected: 垃圾箱应在可见箱体范围内挡人，旁边空地应允许通过。
zh.steps: 走近后巷院落东墙北侧的大垃圾箱，先尝试穿过箱体东侧边缘，再尝试通过紧邻箱体西侧的空地。

en.criteria: You can walk into one side of the dumpster, while empty space beside the opposite side blocks your movement.
en.expected: The dumpster should block movement within its visible body, not in the surrounding empty space.
en.steps: Approach the northern dumpster along the courtyard’s east wall. Try walking through its eastern edge, then through the open space immediately west of it.

zh.criteria: 金属垃圾桶在离开再返回后变得透明，可以看到桶身后面的物体。
zh.expected: 金属垃圾桶应保持不透明。
zh.steps: 从南侧靠近后巷目标垃圾桶至三米内并看清桶身，绕开桶走到至少九米外，再返回。重新加载案例可再次测试。

en.criteria: A metal wastebin becomes see-through after you walk away and return.
en.expected: The metal bin should remain opaque.

zh.expected: 不透明物体从合理的各侧观察都应可见。
zh.steps: 绕到目标前后两侧，比较可见性。
zh.criteria: 确认以下现象可复现：出生点东北方坡上的大巨石（约25米远）从出生点一侧（南面）看得见，从它北面（上坡一侧）看却完全消失。

en.expected: An opaque object should remain visible when inspected from its different sides.
en.steps: Inspect the target from its front and back and compare visibility.
en.criteria: Confirm that the following is reproducible: the big boulder up the slope north-east of the start (about 25 m away) is visible from the start side (south) but vanishes completely when viewed from its north (uphill) side

zh.expected: 前方不透明物体应正确遮挡后方目标。
zh.steps: 让柱子、墙壁或岩石处于目标前方，检查遮挡。
zh.criteria: 确认以下现象可复现：出生点东北方坡上的大巨石（约25米远）会透过前方一切物体显示出来——隔着树木、灌木甚至山坡本身仍然可见。

en.expected: Opaque foreground geometry should occlude the target behind it.
en.steps: Place a column, wall or rock between you and the target and inspect occlusion.
en.criteria: Confirm that the following is reproducible: the big boulder up the slope north-east of the start (about 25 m away) renders through everything in front of it - it stays visible through trees, bushes and the hillside itself

zh.expected: 随距离变化，外观应合理连续，不应突然变为粗糙占位体。
zh.steps: 逐渐远离并靠近目标，比较近景和远景外观。
zh.criteria: 确认以下现象可复现：出生点西侧约12米的高大松树，只要你离它超过约16米就显示为一个粗糙的平面着色绿色圆锥，走近后才突然变成有细节的树。

en.expected: Appearance should remain coherent with distance without abrupt placeholder geometry.
en.steps: Gradually move away from and toward the target to compare near and far appearance.
en.criteria: Confirm that the following is reproducible: the tall pine west of the start (about 12 m away) shows as a crude flat-shaded green cone whenever you are more than ~16 m from it, and pops into a detailed tree only when you come closer

zh.expected: 物体应合理放置，不应有大量重复副本挤在同一位置。
zh.steps: 靠近描述的目标，从不同角度观察并与相邻物体比较。
zh.criteria: 确认以下现象可复现：出生点西南方、靠近水边的开阔草地上，九块完全相同的小巨石紧紧挤成一堆、互相穿插（生成失败）。

en.expected: Objects should be placed normally without a pile of interpenetrating duplicates.
en.steps: Approach the described target, inspect it from different viewpoints and compare nearby objects.
en.criteria: Confirm that the following is reproducible: nine identical small boulders are jammed into one another in one tight heap on the open grass south-west of the start, near the water (failed spawns)

zh.expected: 地形外观与支撑碰撞应一致。
zh.steps: 接近可见缺口并尝试走过。
zh.criteria: 确认以下现象可复现：东侧一块方形地形网格缺失，能看见虚空或远山，但仍可站在不可见地面上走过。

en.expected: Visible terrain and supporting collision should agree.
en.steps: Approach the visible gap and try to cross it.
en.criteria: Confirm that the following is reproducible: a square patch of the ground east of the start is MISSING - a hole in the terrain mesh shows the void / the far hills through it, yet you can still walk across the gap on invisible ground

zh.expected: 树根应在地面，树冠在上方。
zh.steps: 观察树冠与树干的上下关系。
zh.criteria: 确认以下现象可复现：出生点西北方（约20米远，坡上）的大圆冠树上下颠倒——树冠贴在地面上，光秃秃的树干从树冠顶部直直伸向天空。

en.expected: The tree should have its roots at ground level and crown above.
en.steps: Inspect the vertical relationship of the trunk and crown.
en.criteria: Confirm that the following is reproducible: the big round-crowned tree north-west of the start (about 20 m away, up the slope) is UPSIDE DOWN - its leafy crown rests on the ground and its bare trunk sticks straight up out of the top of the crown into the sky
